llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define and register a ProductDetails screen route in the stack navigator.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: ProductDetails is defined as a screen in the stack navigator's screens object.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must pass a title param when navigating from list to product details.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Both navigation.navigate('ProductDetails', ...) calls only pass productId; no title param is ever included.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must handle missing productId with a deterministic fallback display instead of showing stale or undefined values.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No fallback handling for missing/undefined productId; route.params is cast directly without a nullish check or default value.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use useNavigation to get the navigation object.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useNavigation is imported and called in both ProductDetailsScreen and ProductsScreen.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createNativeStackNavigator is called with a static config object and the result is passed to createStaticNavigation, which is rendered as <Navigation />.
